title: Quick Melted Ukrainian Cheese Bake
description: A quick and delicious Ukrainian dish featuring Chinese broccoli, melted cheese, and a buttery crust.

ingredients.name: 1 cup of grated Ukrainian cheese (e.g., Ukrainian Feta or Russian Feta)
ingredients.notes: You can use any other sharp cheese

instructions: In a large skillet, melt 1/4 cup of butter over medium heat. Add the Chinese broccoli and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the Ukrainian cheese, mozzarella cheese, and Parmesan cheese.
Add the cooked Chinese broccoli to the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the cheese and broccoli mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Dot the top of the dish with the remaining 1/4 cup of butter.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
